maddeler.e:
استوئي (form X)
# اُسْتُوئِيَ (ustūʔiya) /us.tuː.ʔi.ja/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
# اِسْتَوْئِي (istawʔī) /is.taw.ʔiː/: second-person feminine singular imperative of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
